opportunities.title: APEX Awards
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Lead applicant must be an exceptional, independent researcher with a strong track record, based at a UK university or not‑for‑profit research organisation, holding a permanent or fixed‑term position and having teaching and admin duties; co‑applicants must be independent researchers from a different Academy remit.
opportunities.summary: Interdisciplinary, curiosity‑driven research awards for established researchers, up to 24 months, up to £200k.

opportunities.title: SHAPE Involve and Engage
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any UK‑based researcher across career stages; must have some prior public‑engagement experience; previous award‑holders cannot re‑apply.
opportunities.summary: Public‑engagement awards for humanities and social sciences researchers to deliver innovative projects with GLAM or performing‑arts partners.

opportunities.title: The Alexander von Humboldt Foundation and The British Academy Knowledge Frontiers Symposium 2027
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career researchers in the humanities or social sciences affiliated with a UK or German research institution.
opportunities.summary: Symposium for ~15 UK and 15 German early‑career scholars to discuss ‘Humans and Nature’; travel, accommodation and seed funding provided.

opportunities.title: Postdoctoral Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career researchers in the humanities or social sciences with a PhD awarded between 1 Apr 2024 and 1 Apr 2027, based at a UK university or research organisation, not holding a permanent academic post.
opportunities.summary: Three‑year fellowships funded by DSIT covering 80 % of salary costs, starting Autumn 2027.

opportunities.title: Talent Development Awards 2026-27
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK‑resident researchers with a long‑term appointment at a UK HEI or independent research organisation, working in the humanities or social sciences.
opportunities.summary: 6‑12 month awards to develop quantitative, digital or language skills and to disseminate them within and beyond academia.

opportunities.title: International Interdisciplinary Research Projects 2027
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK‑based principal investigator from the humanities or social sciences, post‑doctoral or above, with overseas co‑applicants; PI must hold a position lasting the award duration.
opportunities.summary: 24‑month interdisciplinary projects on mobilities, involving any SHAPE or STEM discipline, with international partners.

opportunities.title: Global Innovation Fellowships: The German Council on Foreign Relations (DGAP) 2026-27
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK‑based early‑ or mid‑career researchers in the humanities or social sciences.
opportunities.summary: One‑year fellowships hosted at DGAP in Berlin to produce policy‑relevant analysis in security, Indo‑European relations, technology/AI or strategy‑making.

opportunities.title: Additional Needs

amount.raw: up to £4,000 (higher amounts possible with justification)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Current British Academy award‑holders or applicants intending to apply for a British Academy award within the next six months.
opportunities.summary: Funding to support equipment, caring costs, accessibility or mental‑health support needed to apply for or deliver a British Academy award.
